title: 科技股已明显回调：但仍是领涨？，领先优势缩小中
speaker: Viata Mante

segments.en: We haven't as well. True, true. Relatively speaking. So the way we see it, we've had a bit of pullback because tech was such a heavy overweight that there was no space for anything else.
segments.zh: 相对而言，确实如此。我们看到科技股此前权重过高，导致其他板块没有空间。

segments.en: And as we move into this broadening phase, some space needs to be given up for other cyclical bits of the market. So tech has to come off with the way it would argue it's already come off substantially. But it's not moving completely away from tech.
segments.zh: 随着市场进入广度扩大阶段，需要为其他周期性板块腾出空间。科技股已经明显回调，但并未完全离场。

segments.en: It tech becomes part of this broadening, right? So the investment in AI actually allow us to start thinking about AI adoption and the broader set of sectors or countries, regions that feed into that adoption.
segments.zh: 科技本身也是广度扩大的一部分。对AI的投入让我们开始思考AI的应用，以及受益的行业和地区。

segments.en: So a more abrupt giving way of tech would take the market down as well, right? So probably we are in a soft spot right now.
segments.zh: 如果科技股突然大幅回调，也会拖累整个市场。所以我们现在可能处于一个调整期。

segments.en: And we do see if I've mentioned all these positive indicators for the rest of the market, however tech isn't at the top of it, right? It's still a leader, but not the leader by that far. It's a leader by that far.
segments.zh: 我们看到其他市场有很多积极信号，科技股仍是领导者，但领先优势已不那么明显。
